answer: Onyx vault: each identity must keep 50 GB of identity-seeded sealed storage, about 6 hours of sealing and $0.40/month per fake. Each epoch a verifier sends a ripple of 32 random offsets; the identity must return Merkle proofs within 2 seconds, too fast to re-seal on demand, so a missing or shared disk fails. Every sealed timber block is keyed to its own identity, so a farm cannot reuse one drive across aliases: 1,000 fakes need 50 TB and 6,000 sealing hours. Limit: a rich farm can still pay, but cost scales linearly.
